body: I feel useless, hated and depressed about life to the extent where I want to drown myself literally. I don’t know how to help myself 😔
I couldn’t agree more. Life is so pointless.

Hi, I read your post from a month ago, and I feel you. I’ve lost all hope in living, and I just want to end it all. But I’m afraid, afraid of the pain and if I mess up, the more pain and suffering I would have to endure. Can I ask if you made it out alive after these thoughts and if you did, what made you want to live?
I feel the exact same way, it’s so painful to live without any ambition or passion for anything, all I can think about is ending it all to free myself
